cues.zh: 柯林斯参议员，感谢您接受采访。
cues.en: Senator Collins, thanks for coming in.

cues.zh: 非常荣幸，谢谢。
cues.en: It's a great pleasure, thank you.

cues.zh: 本周在西澳大利亚发生事故的那艘船……
cues.en: This ship that was involved in the incident in Western Australia this week...

cues.zh: 就是船头掉下来的那艘？
cues.en: The one the front fell off?

cues.zh: 对，对，这可不常见，我想强调这一点。
cues.en: Yeah. Yeah, that's not very typical, I'd like to make that point.

cues.zh: 那它怎么不常见了？
cues.en: Well, how was it un-typical?

cues.zh: 世界上一直有大量这类船在航行，这种事极少发生。
cues.en: Well there are a lot of these ships going around the world all the time, and very seldom does anything like this happen.

cues.zh: 我只是不想让人以为油轮不安全。
cues.en: I just don't want people thinking that tankers aren't safe.

cues.zh: 这艘油轮安全吗？
cues.en: Was this tanker safe?

cues.zh: 呃，我更关心的是其他那些船。
cues.en: Well, I was thinking more about the other ones.

cues.zh: 那些安全的船？对，船头不会掉的那些。
cues.en: The ones that are safe? Yeah, the ones the front doesn't fall off.

cues.zh: 那如果这艘不安全，为什么它装了8万吨石油？
cues.en: Well, if this wasn't safe why did it have 80,000 tons of oil on it?

cues.zh: 我没说不安全，只是可能不如其他一些船那么安全。
cues.en: I'm not saying it wasn't safe, it's just perhaps not quite as safe as some of the other ones.

cues.zh: 为什么？因为有些船的设计就是让船头根本不会掉。
cues.en: Why? Well, some of them are built so that the front doesn't fall off at all.

cues.zh: 这船不就是设计成船头不会掉吗？
cues.en: Wasn't this built so that the front wouldn't fall off?

cues.zh: 显然不是。你怎么知道的？
cues.en: Well, obviously not. Well, how do you know?

cues.zh: 因为船头掉了，两万吨原油泄漏到海里还起了火。
cues.en: Well, because the front fell off and 20,000 tons of crude oil spilled into the sea caught fire.

cues.zh: 这就很说明问题了。我只是想强调，这并不正常。
cues.en: It's a bit of a giveaway. I'd just like to make the point that it's not normal.

cues.zh: 这些油轮是按什么工程标准建造的？
cues.en: Well what sort of engineering standards are these oil tankers built to?

cues.zh: 哦，非常严格的海事工程标准。
cues.en: Oh, very rigorous maritime engineering standards.

cues.zh: 比如说？起码船头就不该掉吧。
cues.en: What sort of thing? Well, the front's not supposed to fall off for a start.

cues.zh: 还有别的吗？
cues.en: And what other things?

cues.zh: 有规定限制可以用什么材料来建造。
cues.en: Well, there are regulations governing what materials they can be made of.

cues.zh: 什么材料？纸板肯定不行。
cues.en: What materials? Well, cardboard's out.

cues.zh: 还有呢？纸板衍生材料也不行。
cues.en: And? No cardboard derivatives.

cues.zh: 喜欢纸吗？不用纸。不用绳子。不用胶带。
cues.en: Like paper? No paper. No string. No sellotape.

cues.zh: 橡胶？不行，橡胶也不行。
cues.en: Rubber? No, rubber's out.

cues.zh: 嗯，他们得有个方向盘。有最低船员配置要求。
cues.en: Umm, they've got to have a steering wheel. There's a minimum crew requirement.

cues.zh: 最低船员是多少？哦，我猜一个吧。
cues.en: What's the minimum crew? Oh, one I suppose.

cues.zh: 所以有人说它们的设计就是不顾后果地尽可能多装油，这种说法很荒谬？
cues.en: So the allegations that they're just designed to carry as much oil as possible no matter the consequences, that's ludicrous?

cues.zh: 绝对荒谬，这些是非常非常坚固的船。
cues.en: Absolutely ludicrous, these are very very strong vessels.

cues.zh: 那发生了什么？嗯，这次是船头掉了，但这种情况非常罕见。
cues.en: So what happened? Well, the front fell off in this case by all means, but it's very unusual.

cues.zh: 但是Collins参议员，船头为什么会掉？
cues.en: But Senator Collins, why did the front fall off?

cues.zh: 嗯，一个浪打上来了。
cues.en: Well a wave hit it.

cues.zh: 一个浪打上来了？
cues.en: A wave hit it?

cues.zh: 一个浪打中了船。
cues.en: A wave hit the ship.

cues.zh: 这罕见吗？哦是的。在海上？百万分之一的概率！
cues.en: Is that unusual? Oh yeah. At sea? Chance in a million!

cues.zh: 那遇到这种情况你们怎么保护环境？
cues.en: So what do you do to protect the environment in cases like this?

cues.zh: 嗯，船被拖到了环境外面。
cues.en: Well the ship was towed outside the environment.

cues.zh: 拖到另一个环境里了？不，不，是被拖到环境之外了。
cues.en: Into another environment? No, no, it was towed beyond the environment.

cues.zh: 它不在环境里。
cues.en: It's not in the environment.

cues.zh: 不，是从一个环境拖到另一个环境。
cues.en: No but from one environment to another environment.

cues.zh: 不，是在环境之外。它不在任何环境里。
cues.en: No it's beyond the environment. It's not in an environment.

cues.zh: 它被拖到环境之外了。但它总得在某个地方吧……
cues.en: It's been towed beyond the environment. But it must be somewhere...

cues.zh: 那，外面有什么？
cues.en: Well, what's out there?

cues.zh: 外面什么都没有！
cues.en: Nothing's out there!

cues.zh: 外面肯定有什么东西。外面什么都没有——只有海、鸟和鱼。
cues.en: Well there must be something out there. There is nothing out there - all there is is sea and birds and fish.

cues.zh: 还有呢？还有两万吨原油。
cues.en: And? And 20,000 tons of crude oil.

cues.zh: 还有别的吗？还有火。
cues.en: And what else? And fire.

cues.zh: 还有别的吗？还有船头断掉的那部分船体。
cues.en: And anything else? And the part of the ship that the front fell off.

cues.zh: 但外面没有别的东西了。
cues.en: But there's nothing else out there.

cues.zh: 柯林斯参议员，感谢接受采访。
cues.en: Senator Collins, thanks for joining us.

cues.zh: 就是一片彻底的虚空。
cues.en: It's a complete void.

cues.zh: 好，我们时间到了。环境完全安全。我们时间到了？
cues.en: Yeah, we're out of time. The environment's perfectly safe. We're out of time?

cues.zh: 嗯，你能帮我叫辆出租车吗？
cues.en: Yeah. Can you book me a cab?

cues.zh: 可你不是坐联邦的车来的吗？
cues.en: But didn't you come in a commonwealth car?

cues.zh: 是的，但……怎么回事？……嗯，车头掉了。
cues.en: Yes I did but... What happened? ... well, the front fell off.
